title: Operators of Hilbert type acting on some spaces of analytic functions
summary: Let $H(\mathbb{D})$ be the space of all analytic functions in the unit disc $\mathbb{D}$. For $g\in H(\mathbb{D})$, the generalized Hilbert operator $\mathcal{H}_{g}$ is defined by $$\mathcal{H}_{g}(f)(z)=\int_{0}^{1}f(t)g'(tz)dt, \ \ z\in \mathbb{D}, f\in H(\mathbb{D}).$$ In this paper, we study the operator $\mathcal{H}_{g}$ acting on some spaces of analytic functions in $\mathbb{D}$.
